title: Parvathy to Samantha, celebs wish Nazriya Nazim healing after emotional post
summary: Actor Nazriya Nazim Fahadh revealed she stepped away from social media to focus on her emotional well-being. In an extended Instagram post she apologised for going quiet and said she is working on healing. Several colleagues — including Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Parvathy, Tovino Thomas and Soubin Shahir — sent messages of support as fans and friends wished her a speedy recovery.
content:
Actor Nazriya Nazim Fahadh broke her silence on her absence from social media, stating that she was struggling with her 'emotional well-being'. In a lengthy Instagram post, she explained the reason behind her staying away from the limelight. Soon, her post was filled with encouraging messages from her peers, including Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Parvathy, Tovino Thomas and Soubin Shahir, among others.

Her fans and colleagues wished her speedy recovery and healing. Actor Meghana Raj, who is Nazriya's close friend, wrote, "We love u baby girl! Always there for u! U know that! (sic)," with a heart emoji.

Actor Vijay Varma had a special message for Nazriya, which read, "Wishing you all the love and healing (sic)."

Take a look at some of the comments:

On Wednesday, Nazriya explained why she had been away from social media. "Over the past few months, I've been struggling with my emotional wellbeing and personal challenges that have made it difficult for me to be present (sic)," her statement read.

The 'Raja Rani' actor stated that she missed celebrating her 30th birthday, New Year's, success of 'Sookshmadarshini' and several important moments. Apologising to her friends, she wrote, "I also want to apologise to all my friends for not explaining why I went missing and for not picking up calls or responding to messages. I'm truly sorry for any worry or inconvenience I may have caused. I did shut down completely (sic)."

Here's Nazriya Nazim Fahadh's statement:

Nazriya then apologised to her colleagues who had been trying to reach out to her work.

The actor is now recuperating and aims to get back to work soon. "It's been a tough journey, but I want you to know that I'm working on healing and getting better every day. I appreciate your understanding and support during this time. I may need a bit more time to fully return, but I promise I'm on path to recovery (sic)," she wrote.

She was last seen in the Malayalam film, 'Sookshmadarshini'.
